metrics.layer_count_definition: Nondecreasing receiving-body/root support courses; not hanging-tip bottomZ or slicing layers.

descriptive_pattern_metrics.scope: Occupied8mm/4.8mm source sample andwhole-part palette projectedonto the same normalizedbody. Excludes studs,gaps,chamfers andsupports; realCGmustbeviewed separately.

front.interpretation: Descriptive projected geometry overlap/boundary distance; no aesthetic or mechanical pass threshold

side.interpretation: Descriptive projected geometry overlap/boundary distance; no aesthetic or mechanical pass threshold

painted_feature_region.interpretation: Nearest source palette labels on actual registered visible surfaces. Face pose, color regions and gaps influence this statistic; it does not declare likeness approval.

descriptive_pattern_metrics.region_definition: Tight reference-front bbox of all non-base colorcells plus5pixels; not automatic anatomical landmark detection.
descriptive_pattern_metrics.interpretation: Differences are descriptive. Morepieces are not a validated likeness percentage or mechanical completion.

front.framing_method: Actual native vertex projection, not empty bounding-box corners; center and screen-height normalization per model.
front.normalization_note: The four shapes occupy equal screen height; this image group is NOT a physical size comparison.

three_quarter.framing_method: Actual native vertex projection, not empty bounding-box corners; center and screen-height normalization per model.
three_quarter.normalization_note: The four shapes occupy equal screen height; this image group is NOT a physical size comparison.

limitations_ja: 倍率は実部品数で、寸法倍率ではありません。比較1xは本人不在時の暫定前提です。
完成サイズ増加で元形状の相対格子解像度を上げていますが、色境界は初期C参照で、美観改善の保証ではありません。
放射状分解は説明図。物理的に衝突せず分解できる保証ではありません。下からの順序は公称支持の検査で、保持力は未確認です。
元の本体内の実部品を一体の受け・根元へ再構成し、外付け/仮の組立支台を不要とする候補です。実CADの接触・挿入・断面・全荷重prefixを検査済みですが、現物保持力や印刷時サポート不要は未確認です。
limitations_en: The multiplier is actual physicalpiececount, not linearsize. The1xbaseline is a provisional creator assumption while the user was unavailable.
Larger fixed-pitch sampling increases relative contour resolution; colors reference initialC. More parts do not guarantee better appearance.
Radial explosion is explanatory, not collision-free physical disassembly. Bottom-up order has nominal support checks, not verified retention.

Existing body material is joined into real seated internal supports, with no external or temporary assembly stands. Native contact/insertion/sections/all nominal load prefixes are checked; physical retention and slicer-support requirements remain unvalidated.

assembly_support.method: Real continuous same-color stepped beam/root modules; unchanged body envelope and 8mm root interfaces, no floor stands.

observations_ja: 新actualID copilot-p120-support-free-v2の実21,382部品・156型を確認。固定分母17,873と目標21,448は不変で、差-66は許容内。旧21,388部品の7個を実1個の本体内受けへ置き換えた差-6であり、単に支台を隠した案ではない。
完成正面・斜め・放射分解・登録正面の実CG4枚と、実144frame/12fps/12秒/3章動画のframe1/18/54/73/108/144、根元挿入77/78/79/80を閲覧した。ゴーグル・顔・側面の外観と見える色を保ち、旧床柱は存在しない。

旧seed COPILOT-P120-000313（旧step267、実底面Z16.0mm）は、既存受け000421と既存内部000412/000422/000432/000442/000452へ材料連続で接続した。新BS-0e9661fb7ce065e5は79.8x71.8x9.6mm、真のbodybottomZ16.0を維持し、受け側Z20.8の48接点から支持される。元占有セル・全色・非変更部品の位置を保持し、床への柱や重りを追加しない。
本体受けcourse4を先に組み、その後course5/新step374で根元を入れる。実動画77〜80で受け側と根元の周辺工程を確認した。接続段階Z20.8と物体底面Z16.0を分け、Z値を偽装しない。
実nativeの単一solid・接触面/bearing・非干渉・挿入・全support/insertion先行関係が成立し、元/別展開のFreeCADで全21,382ID/type/color/pose/stepが一致した。
根元自身と後続19部品の全20prefixで、公称一様密度CADの静モーメント余裕は最小18.182694mmとなり、従来の1mm基準を維持した。選定用proxy値ではなく実BRep volume/centroidによる別検査である。
前方下縁の荷重方向に対してX/Y断面と段差の実接続neckを検査した。実18断面の最小面積52.588563mm²、局所Z4.8の接続neck60.84mm²、真の下面屋根1.6mm。測定追加時もnative FCStd/STEP/STL/mesh bytesは不変だった。
保存Blender sceneの156型の実頂点・面、全instanceの材質/位置/step、放射分解からの絶対復帰と本体0→全数を照合した。外部/仮の組立支台は実0個で、frame73にも支台はない。
現物のPLA・インフィルの質量、保持力、曲げ、クリープ、手のアクセス、転倒、スライサーのサポート要否は未検証。外観の採用と印刷は未承認。旧4案、既存4倍/基準、Mona/Ducky、旧画像や型bytesは変更していない。
observations_en: Actual21,382 pieces/156types for the new copilot-p120-support-free-v2 ID. The17,873 denominator and21,448 target are unchanged; difference-66 is within tolerance. Seven existing parts become one real integrated support, reducing the old21,388count by6 rather than merely hiding an aid.

All four real CG views, actual144-frame/12fps/12-second/three-chapter movie samples1/18/54/73/108/144 and insertion samples77/78/79/80 were inspected. Goggles, face, sides and visible colors remain; the old floor prop does not exist.

Original seed COPILOT-P120-000313(oldstep267,truebottomZ16.0mm) connects continuously to existing receiver000421 and internal parts000412/000422/000432/000442/000452. BS-0e9661fb7ce065e5 measures79.8x71.8x9.6mm, preserves truebottomZ16.0 and seats on48contact sites at Z20.8. Original occupied cells, all colors and unaffected part poses are preserved; no floor-reaching post or ballast is added.

Receiver course4 precedes root course5/newstep374. Actual frames77-80 show the surrounding receiving/insertion sequence. Support-stage Z20.8 is distinct from physical part-bottomZ16.0; no Z falsification is used.

Actual native single-solid/contact/bearing/noninterference/insertion and all support/insertion predecessor checks pass. Original and relocated FreeCAD reopening match all21,382IDs/types/colors/poses/steps.

The module and19later payload parts give20verified assembly prefixes with minimum nominal uniform-CAD-density static margin18.182694mm, preserving the1mmgate. This is actual BRep volume/centroid evidence, not the layout-selection proxy.

X/Y sections and the actual stepped material neck address the front-lip load direction. Eighteen sections have minimum area52.588563mm2; the localZ4.8neck is60.84mm2 and true cavity roof1.6mm. NativeFCStd/STEP/STL/mesh bytes remained unchanged during measurement enrichment.

The saved Blender scene matches156native mesh types and every instance's material/pose/step, absolute radial return and empty-to-full assembly. There are zero actual external or temporary assembly aids, including at frame73.

Physical PLA/infill mass, retention, bending, creep, hand access, tipping and slicer-support requirements remain untested. Visual adoption and printing are unapproved. The four historical cases, existing4x/reference, Mona/Ducky, prior images and existing type bytes are unchanged.
